# FG-CI-0025

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_merge_request_already_in_the_queue_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この MR はマージキューに入れられません（すでに入っている、開いていない、またはキューに入っていません）。MR の状態を確かめてください。
- en: This merge request cannot be added to or removed from the merge queue (it is already queued, not open, or not in the queue). Check the merge request's state.
- id: Merge request ini tidak dapat dimasukkan ke atau dikeluarkan dari antrean merge (sudah ada di antrean, tidak terbuka, atau tidak ada di antrean). Periksa status merge request.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C8 (ADR-0030 §2, §10): `POST …/merge-requests/{iid}/merge-queue` or `DELETE` of it was refused by the queue's own state: `reason=already_queued` (the merge request has a live entry — queued or being tested), `not_queued` (a removal of a merge request with no live entry), `landing` (a removal while its batch is landing: the landing owns it), `not_open` (closed or merged); and `POST …/merge-requests/{iid}/merge` of a merge request in the queue is `reason=already_queued` (remove it from the queue first), `head_changed` is not this code (FG-REVIEW-0008). Whether the merge request may be merged at all is decided before (FG-AUTH-0003, FG-REVIEW-0007 with its reasons, FG-REVIEW-0011 for a live merge attempt). Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `merge_request_id`, `entry_id` (the live entry, when there is one) and `request_id`. `gstn queue status --project <id> <iid>` shows the live entry and its position.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing on the server: an already queued merge request waits for its turn (remove it first to re-add it); a closed one must be reopened.
